title: Art. 8.1.10 — Annex 14 - Aerodromes, Volume I - Aerodrome Design and Operations, Chapter 8 - Electrical Systems, 8.1 Electric power supply systems for air navigation facilities, Application, 8.1.10
content:
Recommendation.— The following aerodrome facilities should be provided with a secondary power supply capable of supplying power when there is a failure of the primary power supply:

e) essential security lighting, if provided in accordance with 9.11;
